issues.description: Stock.getStockIngredients() has inconsistent return types between template and solution. In the template repository, Stock.getStockIngredients() returns List<StockIngredient> (wrapping the internal array via Arrays.asList), while in the solution repository it returns StockIngredient[]. Students relying on the template API may implement code using List operations or expect a List in tests, but the reference solution exposes an array, making the expected public API unclear.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the public API across template and solution. Prefer returning StockIngredient[] (as in the solution and UML association concept) by changing the template’s getStockIngredients() signature and implementation accordingly (and adjust any dependent example code/tests).

issues.description: SealSaloon.getStock() is implemented as a static method in the solution, but the provided template Main demonstrates calling it as an instance method (shop.getStock()). This mismatch can mislead students about whether the getter should be static or instance, especially because the problem statement also requires the stock field itself to be static/shared.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the access style consistent across artifacts: either change the example/template to use SealSaloon.getStock(), or change the solution (and intended student API) to provide an instance getter public Stock getStock() that returns the shared static stock.

issues.description: The problem statement describes the build/exercise as "H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon", but both template and solution Gradle settings use a rootProject.name that references a different exercise ("H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House"). This inconsistency can confuse students when importing/running the project and when matching the assignment name to the repository/project name.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename rootProject.name in both template and solution settings.gradle to match the assignment name (e.g., "H02E02---Panic-at-Seal-Saloon"), or update the problem statement if the intended project name is different.
